title: [Tempest Queen, Smoking Lounge]
description: Reserved for gentlemen, the richly appointed lounge smells of fragrant tobacco.  Opposite a gilded arch, a pair of brass-buttoned dark leather couches faces each other across a low ivory-inlaid table.  A felt-topped gaming table is arranged with a quartet of high-backed chairs, a trolley nearby stocked with playing cards and white jade dice.
